definitions.explanation: Having deep compassion and mercy toward others, especially those who are suffering. Often used to describe people who show warmth and generosity toward the weak or unfortunate.

examples.japanese: {慈悲深|じひぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慈悲深|じひぶか}い⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧。
examples.english: That monk treats people with a compassionate heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慈悲深|じひぶか}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かける→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけていた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother had a compassionate nature and would always speak to anyone she saw in trouble.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{慈悲|じひ}→慈悲：10889_jihi⟧ (mercy, compassion) and ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep). ⟦{慈悲|じひ}→慈悲：10889_jihi⟧ originally comes from Buddhist terminology: {慈|じ} (loving-kindness, giving happiness) and {悲|ひ} (compassion, removing suffering). The word retains a somewhat elevated, literary tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慈悲深|じひぶか}い⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧: a compassionate heart
- {慈悲深|じひぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a merciful person
- {慈悲深|じひぶか}い⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧: an act of mercy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {優|やさ}しい: kind, gentle — the everyday word for kindness, much more common in conversation
- ⟦{思|おも}いやり→思いやり：06651_omoiyari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: considerate, thoughtful — focuses on being attentive to others' feelings
- ⟦{情|なさ}け{深|ぶか}い→情け深い：16074_nasakebukai⟧: merciful, sympathetic — similar meaning but slightly more everyday than {慈悲深|じひぶか}い
